title: Bug 641085: Document Check factbox does not update live on Purchase Invoice/Cr.Memo/Return Order
summary: The Document Check factbox on Purchase Invoice, Purchase Credit Memo, and Purchase Return Order now updates live when lines are edited, instead of requiring a manual page refresh.
key_points: Document Check factbox now refreshes immediately when editing purchase invoice, credit memo, or return order lines
Fixed three event subscribers that were incorrectly calling the Purchase Order's global page instead of their own document's page
Behavior now matches the already-correct Purchase Order and Sales subform handlers
quote: line edits never refreshed the open page's Document Check factbox (only F5 did)
